text_block_list.text:
Wow! What a heroic rescue! Thanks,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Wait... Oh no! Some of them are still left
behind!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Okay! Next time, I'll bring Taishin and
Hayahide,
and we'll get the rest of you
out!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Just hold on! I'll come back with my
friends!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
